title: Finite global sections of a prime-annihilated boundary sheaf
statement: Let k be algebraically closed, Λ a commutative ring, and f:X → Spec k a curve. Let Q be a constructible étale Λ-module sheaf killed by a prime ℓ, with Λ/(ℓ) finite. If Q restricts to zero on a dense open V, then H⁰(X,Q) is finite.

source.place: Tag 0GJA, finite product of boundary stalks

proof.text: The complement of V is finite and zero-dimensional. The open-closed exact sequence identifies Q with the closed direct image of its restriction to this complement. Zero-dimensional etale cohomology identifies global sections with a finite product of stalks. Constructibility makes each stalk finitely generated over Λ; annihilation by ℓ makes it a finitely generated module over the finite quotient Λ/(ℓ), hence finite. A finite product is finite.
